title: DcpRunFacet
description: The DCP events behind one OpenLineage run: one process's share of one DCP trace (run scope trace-process, the default), or every event of one process (run scope process, which may span several traces). Carries the attested edges (each event's parents) that OpenLineage's core inputs/outputs model cannot express, and enough of each envelope to rebuild it exactly.

trace_ids.description: Run scope process only (added in P5.2; optional, so older facets stay valid): every trace the run's events belong to, sorted. trace_id is the first of them.

job.description: The DCP job identity of the run, copied verbatim from the envelope.

events.description: Every DCP event in the run, sorted by edge_id.

trace_id.description: Run scope process only (added in P5.2; optional): this event's own trace. Absent, the event belongs to the facet's trace_id.
